answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted reputation with slashing: each agent identity must lock a refundable deposit before trading, and trust grows only through completed, peer-reviewed work. Mass fake identities then cost real capital each, and misbehavior burns the deposit. Like light through a prism, reputation splits into verifiable facets — history, endorsements, disputes — so a sybil swarm cannot fake depth in all at once. A newcomer starts with a thin pigment of trust, earning a saffron badge only after sustained honest service.
